title: Makes weak coffee.
text:
Makes weak coffee.. I love the idea of this coffee maker. I already own the Black and decker Brew and Go and was looking forward to this one. I like the height of the cups that can be used in this coffee pot vs the Black and Decker. Most "go" mugs are too tall for the Black and Decker. I was looking forward to being able to use my other cups with this one.

I thought this would be comparable since they are so similar. I was disappointed in the Mr. Coffee Personal coffee pot. The grounds didn't even get wet until the water was already run half through it, making the coffee very week. I added more grounds and less water and it was still on the weak side. The difference I see between the two coffee pots that I think might be the problem is the B&D has a cone shaped filter and this one is shaped more like a cup. Apparently the cone holds the water in the filter/coffee longer to make the coffee stronger. I prefer the coffee from the Black and Decker.

It even includes a colorful insulated travel mug that's just the right size. No need to buy expensive pods—this portable coffee maker brews your favorite loose coffee grounds.
